worktrees.name: builder-agent
worktrees.description: Isolated environment for the builder subagent. Handles implementation tasks.
worktrees.notes: Named role metadata for MAT workflows. Isolation via Cursor Agents Window / /worktree / /best-of-n / manual git worktree / mat-wt-*. Default bootstrap is metadata-only (no package/network). Use --install --copy-env when deps + env copy are intentional. Same .cursor/worktree markers on every path.

worktrees.name: verifier-agent
worktrees.description: Isolated environment for the verifier subagent. Runs in read-only mode for validation.
worktrees.notes: The verifier agent inspects builder output in its own worktree without touching mainline files.

optional_cloud_agent_templates.name: cloud-builder-agent
optional_cloud_agent_templates.description: Optional guidance profile for running builder tasks in Cursor Cloud Agents instead of local worktrees.
notes: Advisory metadata only. Cursor does not auto-provision Cloud Agents from this file.
Use when local filesystem isolation is insufficient or reproducibility requires a clean VM.

optional_cloud_agent_templates.name: cloud-verifier-agent
optional_cloud_agent_templates.description: Optional guidance profile for verifier validation runs in isolated Cloud Agent environments.
notes: Advisory metadata only. Start Cloud Agents explicitly from Cursor UI/settings.
Preserve read-only verifier behavior unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.
Do not treat Cloud Agent usage as evidence of live Cursor todo parity.

_notes.lsp_warning: Official Cursor docs note that worktrees may lack LSP support (no integrated linting/type feedback inside worktree agents). Do not assume lint/type-check inside worktree agents until tested and confirmed. See: https://cursor.com/docs/configuration/worktrees#language-server-protocol-lsp-support
_notes.cloud_agents: For stronger isolation, use Cursor Cloud Agents (runs in isolated AWS VMs). Cloud Agents are the recommended alternative to local worktrees when environment parity is critical.
_notes.e2b: E2B sandbox integration is excluded from Phase 1. Evaluate in Stage 7 if programmable remote sandboxes become a hard requirement.
_notes.tmux: Tmux is not used in this Cursor-first architecture. Parallel isolation uses Cursor-managed or manual git worktrees (and optional Cloud Agents); up to 8 concurrent agents is a documented Cursor limit, not automatic per-agent worktree creation.
_notes.cleanup_cap: Cursor default cursor.worktreeMaxCount=25. Prefer exact-path /mat-wt-remove or /delete-worktree; refuse dirty/unmerged unless forced.
